profile.headline: Software Engineer • MS in Computer Science • Proficient in Java, Go, and Python • Creating high-performance, scalable, and resilient microservices to enhance reliability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
profile.summary:
Master’s Degree in Computer Science with a strong background in designing and developing scalable, high-performance back-end systems. Eager to improve front-end (like React) and other tech stack skills.

Proficient in AWS services (Lambdas, S3, DynamoDB), event-driven architectures (Kafka), and automation tools (Jenkins, Spinnaker). Skilled in building resilient microservices, optimizing distributed systems, and streamlining CI/CD pipelines for efficiency and scalability.

Technical Skills:
✅ Programming Languages: Java (6+ years), Go (4+ years), Python (6+ years), JavaScript (2+ years), HTML/CSS (2+ years), Shell Scripts (6+ years)
✅ Tools: Git (6+ years), AWS (4+ years), Jenkins, Spinnaker, CI/CD (4+ years)
✅ Testing: JUnit & Frameworks (6+ years), Agile (4+ years)

I have:
★ Developed and maintained 15+ synchronous and asynchronous distributed backend REST API microservices using Java Spring Boot framework and Go to process data pipelines in an agile environment, delivering efficient, scalable, and stable microservices optimized for high performance
★ Engineered Go’s Sarama Async Producer and Consumer to asynchronously produce 1,000+ daily JSON messages and process 1,000+ Kafka messages within consumer groups, creating seamless, reusable integration components that improved system efficiency
★ Leveraged GitHub Copilot AI (Artificial Intelligence) to generate 500+ lines of relevant code and applied AI-driven automation for unit and functional tests, accelerating development speed, increasing test coverage to 90%+, and enhancing code reliability
★ Built AWS cloud solutions, including Lambda functions and DynamoDB for data processing by handling 1,000+ daily item transactions, boosting data processing efficiency, scalable and reliable storage, and optimized overall system performance

AKA / Misspellings: Tho Nguyen, Todd Nguyen, Todd Nguyen Tran.

#SoftwareEngineer #SoftwareDeveloper #BackendSoftwareEngineer #BackendSoftwareDeveloper #JavaDeveloper #GoDeveloper #PythonDeveloper #AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · E-Commerce

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained 15+ synchronous and asynchronous distributed backend REST API microservices using Java Spring Boot framework and Go to process data pipelines in an agile environment, delivering efficient, scalable, and stable microservices optimized for high performance.
• Engineered reusable Java libraries implemented across 5+ services, reducing development time by 10% and minimizing bugs. Improved code efficiency, streamlined integration, and enhanced productivity for the development team, ensuring faster and more reliable software delivery.
• Engineered Go’s Sarama Async Producer and Consumer to asynchronously produce 1,000+ daily JSON messages and process 1,000+ Kafka messages within consumer groups, creating seamless, reusable integration components that improved system efficiency.
• Leveraged GitHub Copilot AI to generate 500+ lines of relevant code and applied AI-driven automation for unit and functional tests, accelerating development speed, increasing test coverage to 90%+, and enhancing code reliability.
• Optimized database performance by developing a Go-based CRUD library with Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) for DynamoDB, achieving sub-second query execution, faster data retrieval, and improved system responsiveness for high-traffic applications.
• Built AWS cloud solutions, including Lambda functions and DynamoDB for data processing by handling 1,000+ daily item transactions, boosting data processing efficiency, scalable and reliable storage, and optimized overall system performance.
• Developed and deployed Python automation scripts to streamline 10+ critical actions and resolve real-time production issues during on-call rotations, cutting manual workload, improving system reliability, and speeding up incident response times in high-demand environments.
• Accelerated deployment workflows and reduced downtime by leveraging Git, Maven, Jenkins CI/CD, Spinnaker, and Kubernetes to automate deployment of 30+ services.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Apache Kafka · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microservices · Java · Software Development · Go (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · Docker Products · Grafana · OpenSearch · Kafka · Kubernetes · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon S3

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained 3+ large projects using Rust and C++ to read and interpret embedded sensor data, improving data processing speed by 40% and enhancing system reliability and enabling accurate sensor data interpretation for better decision-making.
• Built a Python-integrated automated testing suite that replaced 70% of manual testing, reducing test run time by a week, speeding up development cycles and boosting operational productivity for faster release timelines.
• Implemented Jenkins as a Continuous Integration server using Docker to automate daily test execution, cutting manual testing time by 2+ hours per day and increasing testing efficiency and accelerating deployment workflows.
• Maintained and updated the website using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, improving site responsiveness by 30% and enhancing functionality and providing a better touchscreen user experience, resulting in increased user satisfaction.
• Developed and implemented 20+ automated tests in Java to streamline testing procedures, cutting manual testing efforts by 50% and accelerating development workflows while enhancing testing efficiency.
• Provided support for an Android and iOS app, troubleshooting and optimizing Bluetooth connections, increasing connection stability by 25% and enhancing user experience and ensuring smooth device integration across mobile platforms.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Use jQuery, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to develop a front-end website for displays.
• Develop web automated testing software using Python, Selenium, Kivy, and Django 
• Test various functionalities of Qt's touchscreen and web interface

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented Python and Selenium to automate 1 website and 1 touch screen testing.
• Wrote 5+ procedures and lucid documentation to ensure that anyone can execute automated tests.

positions.title: Eye Tracker Analysis
positions.description:
• Wrote and published a paper on Inferring User Cognitive Style based on Eye Gaze Data. Paper can be accessed on Bronco Scholar at this link: https://scholarworks.calstate.edu/concern/projects/wp988m89t
• Researched Inferring User Cognitive Style based on Eye Gaze Data by employing Python for machine learning and statistical calculations. Concluded that by using real-time eye gaze data, user cognitive style can be predicted if using a High/Low classifier and a Decision Tree implementation.
• Used data obtained from Tobii X-120 and iMotions devices to generate heat maps and to calculate statistics that were used as inputs to the Machine Learning model.
• Presented and defended the research to a panel of Professors, who all approved the defense.

positions.title: Student Office Assistant
positions.description:
• Developing a website to check if a graduate student's thesis or project paper is correctly formatted
• Improving the existing Java program that already checks the thesis or project paper

positions.title: Machine Learning Python
positions.description:
• Implemented Python Machine Learning Models such as VGG16, VGG19, and U-net using Tensorflow.
• Got various first and second places in class competitions using designed models. Class competitions tested the accuracy of male/female prediction and hair/face segmentation.

positions.title: World of Warcraft - Zx Simple UI
positions.description:
• A simple User Interface AddOn using Lua for World of Warcraft that displays Hit Points, Mana / Power Points, Runic bar, Totem bar, etc.
• The user interface has options to move all the bars to wherever the user would like it to be placed.
• The AddOn uses the Ace library for options and database storage.

positions.title: Image Processing & Adaptive Canny Edge
positions.description:
• Individually programmed a Java application to perform various image processing techniques such as image compression or image histogram equalization
• Added an extra Java library so the application can open and read more image file types.
• Implemented an additional image processing algorithm, adaptive canny edge, to detect the edges of an image and display the edges in white with a black background.

positions.title: Connect Five
positions.description:
Connect Four Artificial Intelligence (AI)
• Designed an AI program using Java and the MiniMax algorithm to play the game Connect Four.
• Able to either tie or beat the professor’s implemented AI when the two programs played each other. Also, achieved first place when competing against other students' AI.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Prepare various high school students in subjects such as ACTs & SATs in order to ensure a higher score in these standardized tests
• Assist students with homework help in numerous subjects such as geometry, calculus, etc.

positions.title: Patient Access Advocate
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Extensive expertise relating to the osteoporosis drug FORTEO, especially its clinical functions relating to increasing the amount of osteoblasts present in the body in order to rebuild bone mass.
• Delivered exceptional customer service over the phone by quickly assessing patient needs with friendliness and positivity. Furthermore, took careful notes after every call in order to document it in the system.
• Retained patient’s confidentiality and protected health information according to HIPAA standards via patient authorization and consent in order to ensure no patient information is released to the wrong party.
• Reported adverse events immediately after being made aware of said adverse events by either the patient or caregiver.
• Quickly adapted to various changes to the program by remaining flexible and mastering the changes rapidly.
• Worked with various FORTEO Connect internal teams, i.e. the nurses, to establish a smooth and efficient workflow.

positions.title: Practicum Intern
positions.description:
• Updated patient drug profiles and histories using various Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems such as HelloHealth.
• Followed strict HIPAA laws to protect patient’s personal information during the process of checking in or obtaining info.
• Entered in patient’s information, such as their drug history or insurance information, in an efficient and timely manner.

company.name: Dr. Shawn Hamilton's Internal Medicine Clinical Office

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
• Aided office managers in various tasks such as creating excel sheets for financial records and creating Microsoft Word documents to generate annual reports of purchases.
• Filed & organized numerous invoices and documents for easier access & readability in order to improve work efficiency.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Delivered exceptional customer service by delivering the correct ordered foods in a timely manner.
• Developed and improved communication skills with customers as well as co-workers in order to meet all of the customers’ needs.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Led 40+ members in service projects such as Pugs N' Pals where volunteers were responsible for setting up various playpens for visitors to interact with the pugs that needed a home.
• During the Single Service term, created a YouTube Public Service Announcement video to raise awareness for anti-bullying, with a particular focus in physical and cyber bullying.
• During the Kiwanis Family term, maintained great relationships with the sponsoring Kiwanians, resulting in a $2500 to our Circle K club.
